headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2 in a closely contested matchup, with Spencer Horwitz leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox 6-1, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the charge at the plate.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Adam Frazier of the Los Angeles Angels has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to June 6, 2026. Vaughn Grissom of the Los Angeles Angels has also been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 5, 2026, with a left oblique strain. Additionally, Richie Martin Jr. has joined the Colorado Rockies' roster in a trade with the Texas Rangers.

The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers, who received cash in return. The Los Angeles Angels have also made several roster moves, including placing Adam Frazier on the 10-day injured list and transferring Yoán Moncada from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2 in a closely contested matchup. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings, striking out 3 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Yankees Dominate Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the charge at the plate. Chisholm Jr. hit a crucial 8th home run, a fly ball to right center field, scoring Trent Grisham and Anthony Volpe.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in 4-6 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-6 in a closely contested matchup. Taylor Ward led the Orioles with a home run and two RBIs, while Adam Macko earned the win with a strong 1.0 IP outing, striking out two batters.

top_news.title: **Angels Place Adam Frazier on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels second baseman Adam Frazier has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to June 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers, who received cash in return. Martin Jr. joins the Rockies' roster.
